title: Quarantine invalid SRD mechanics projections
description:
Fix unsafe machine-readable mechanics projections discovered in the ngcj SRD audit.

Problem:
Some records expose fields that appear deterministic, such as spellGrants/resources/effects, but the values are clipped prose or regex residue rather than validated refs or typed objects. Deterministic tools should not have to guess whether a mechanics-looking field is trustworthy.

Examples from the audit:
- Bard Spellcasting includes spellGrants like "two cantrips of your choice from the bard".
- Ranger includes "and replace it with another".
- Warlock Eldritch Invocations includes "compulsion once using a warlock".
- Wizard Spellbook includes "a wizard" and questionable long-rest/proficiency mechanics.

Why this matters:
Missing structure is acceptable as an explicit gap. Bad structure is worse because deterministic tools may consume it as authoritative gameplay data.

Scope:
- Audit feature records and any importer projections that populate machine-readable mechanics-ish fields from regex/prose.
- Make projections fail closed unless they produce validated refs or typed objects.
- Quarantine unresolved extracted prose under an explicitly non-authoritative/evidence/unresolved field, or omit it.
- Add regression tests/gates for clipped prose fragments in mechanics fields.
- Ensure fields such as spellGrants do not contain plain natural-language fragments unless the schema explicitly says they are unresolved prose.

Acceptance criteria:
- No spellGrants/resources/effects/mechanics fields contain clipped natural-language fragments like "and replace it with another" or "two cantrips of your choice from the bard".
- Valid spell grants are stable spell refs or typed grant/choice objects.
- Unresolved prose remains available for DM-model context only in clearly named prose/evidence fields.
- The audit bundle or a dedicated report exposes any remaining unresolved mechanics projections as warnings, not as trusted data.
- npm run typecheck passes.
- npm test passes.
- npm run check passes.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes and regenerated pack output is intentional.
